    Desktop2DAppRegistry.Kind
    How the 2D desktop can run a given command.
    Desktop2DCompositorHost
    Hosts composited native X11 windows inside the conventional 2D desktop: when lg3d runs as the X11 window manager + compositor, each redirected client window is given a Desktop2DWindow whose content is the Swing surface painted by a CompositedWindowHost, so a real external application (a browser, a terminal, ...) appears as an ordinary MDI window in the 2D desktop rather than escaping as a separate top-level window owned by the host window manager.
    Desktop2DCompositorHost.WindowOpener
    Creates and shows the Desktop2DWindow that will embed a composited surface.

    IconGlyphLibrary
    A never-throw bridge over the bundled IconManager glyph library (libs/IconManager-1.6.0.jar) for the icon-pack builder: it enumerates the glyph catalogue by category and renders one glyph to a BufferedImage so IconPackManager.saveUserPack(java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.awt.image.BufferedImage>) can persist it as a PNG in a user pack.
    IconPack
    One icon pack the 2D desktop can theme its application icons with: a named set of PNGs, each keyed by the icon file's base name (for example mail3d.png), that AppIcons consults before it falls back to the procedurally generated IconManager glyph or initials tile.
    IconPack.Source
    Where a pack's PNGs live.
    IconPackManager
    Chooses the icon pack the 2D desktop themes its application icons with, and resolves a single override for one application icon.

    IconRecipe
    An immutable description of how to render one application icon, used by the icon-pack studio to drive the bundled IconManager library's full vocabulary - a glyph or a generative tile as the source, then an appearance chain (tint, gradient, rounded corners, drop shadow, the IconManager.IconEffect post-processors, brightness/contrast, rotation and flip).
    IconRecipe.Builder
    A fluent builder for IconRecipe.
    IconRecipe.Preset
    A ready-made appearance template the studio offers as a starting point.
    IconRecipe.Source
    What the icon is built from before the appearance chain runs.
